question: What does registration revision 3 specify that the pilot never used?

specified.note: 13 coefficients incl. c0 + deltas + delta-deltas, librosa, 25 ms window / 10 ms hop. Features with no learned structure.

Run in the span grid's pooled design (2026-10-29), on the 10,334 sites under joint: best layer 9 on every span, balanced accuracy 0.616–0.625. Ahead of MFCC on every span (C5). Index 0 is not the CNN output but LayerNorm(projection + positional conv), so it carries position (span grid §8).
Index 0 is the input to the first layer; 1–12 are layer outputs. Pretraining data not yet checked against the paper.

answer:
Of the items registration revision 3 specifies, only one never appears in the pilot: **facebook/wav2vec2-base**, a representation with an exploratory role [rep-wav2vec2]. Every other specified item lists run-pilot among its users. These include the four conditions [cond-joint] [cond-random] [cond-speaker] [cond-word], the word-lookup baseline [ctrl-lookup], the [ɾ] environment [env-flap], all three poolings [pool-max] [pool-mean] [pool-midpoint], the linear probe [probe-linear], MFCC and WavJEPA [rep-mfcc] [rep-wavjepa], the control task [task-control], and the speaker-ID and voicing tasks [task-speaker] [task-voicing].

wav2vec2-base was still used, just not in the pilot. It ran in run-rep-communities and in run-span-grid [rep-wav2vec2]. In the span grid's pooled design (2026-10-29), on 10,334 sites under the joint condition, its best layer was 9 on every span, with balanced accuracy of 0.616–0.625. That put it ahead of MFCC on every span (C5) [rep-wav2vec2]. The rows also note that its index 0 is LayerNorm(projection + positional conv) rather than the CNN output, so it carries position [rep-wav2vec2].

So nothing specified in revision 3 went entirely unused. The only gap relative to the pilot is this exploratory representation.
